predictions: Had some things go south in 501 in a few places last week. But aside from those painful finishes, I kinda owned week 8. Season-best (so far!) 19-5 last week, with no more than one wrong in any single division for the first time this season. That brings me to 129-62 (67.5% correct) so far this season, and things are looking up. Or at least they are when I'm not picking matches that involve the Kids, the Outlaws, or the Bandits. With each of those three hot messes, I'm only 2-4 or 2-5 to this point.

Match of the week: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Liquor Possee. We are 8 weeks into the season, and D is led by two teams with the same record and the same point total (with a third team just 6 points back). And here are those two nearly-dead-heat leaders, playing the second round of a pairing that went to Menace back in week two. It's stunning how evenly matched these two are… I'm going Possee in 1001.

Match #2: (B Div.) The Outlaws @ Why So Serious? Serious bounced back from their week 6 loss with a win against the last place team last week, but there is a veritable horde of challengers pounding on the castle doors. And what horde would be complete without some Outlaws in it? I think Serious holds off this challenge, but it will close. 13-11.

Match #3: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ One Armed Bandits. Wing has a serious challenge tonight (see match #6), so if that ends up in a minor upset, the winner of this match could all of a sudden control their own division title fate. The Niners absolutely throttled the Bandits the first time, and while I don't expect that again, I do expect it's Niners, 14-10.

Match #4: (A Div.) Bully for the Element @ Darty Minds. After a slow-ish start, Darty Minds has won three of their last four, and also almost took out Talladega. They are all of a sudden fighting for a spot in the league's top two overall, and a big night against Element would cement that in a big way. But Element is still Element… 16-8.

Match #5: (E Div.) Bottoms Up @ Runs with Corks. This is not quite the same Corks squad that the Bottoms thumped 7 weeks ago. Aside from one 501 nap last week, the Corks haven't lost since then, and are one of the most dangerous teams in E now. Alas, still Bottoms, 14-10.

Match #6: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Wing & A Plaque. The Secrets are in the bottom three in C… and they're also only 2 wins and 12 points out of first place! I really do think they are one of Wing's biggest remaining hurdles. Wing gets it in just the last 501.

Match #7: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Sofa Kings. The lead pair in F has a decent lead on the rest of the division, so there is probably only time for one team to make a run at them. That last potential chase team will almost certainly be the winner of this one. DT, 13-11.

Match #8: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Sharky's Machine. There is a veritable chasm between 4th and 5th in E. That means there is a pretty hot 4-team melee to determine which two teams are likely to head to F in the fall. Despite being a SCkt flop, it's Machine, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Fringe Prime. Geez, the pack of A teams that sit between the leader and the cellar can put forth roughly any outcome every week. That is waaaay out of the ordinary for A. I'm guessing Show Me stays in the top three, 13-11.

Match #10: (B Div.) Kids Mis-B-having @ Raging Bulls. In B div., next-to-the-lead vs. next-to-last is a very short trip. The Kids are on a 2-game run and are looking for a 3rd, but Raging just has a little more heat lately. Raging keeps hold of their 2nd place slot, 15-9.

Match #11: (G Div.) Flight Risks @ Bright side of Flights. Even with their loss last week, Bright side is still within reach of the Risks and 2nd place. The Risks just keep pulling them out though, 14-10.
Match #12: (D Div.) Irish Ton @ Darty Sanchez. While matches among the top three in D are most critical, the next most critical are those against the top chase team. Sanchez narrowly escapes, 13-11.
And the remaining 12 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Talladega Flights 17, Inconsistently Consistent 7.
B Division: Hump Day! 15, Mulligan's Mafia 9.
C Division: Shooter McGavin 14, Rif Raf 10.
D Division: Dirty Darts 14, Constantly 10; Wonders 13, Rangers 11.
E Division: Cheap Shots 14, Ton 80 Proof 10; Waddle 15, Rippin 9.
F Division: That's What She Said 14, She-nanigans 10; The Dartifacts 15, Shark Shooters 9; Dart Knights 14, Nein Mark 10.
